credits.third_party_body:
Built with gratitude on open-source software and open geospatial data:
• Engine, Physics & Runtimes: Godot Engine 4.8 (Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur & contributors — MIT); Jolt Physics / Godot Jolt (Jorrit Rouwe, Mikael Hermansson & contributors — MIT); .NET 10, WPF, System.IO.Hashing, System.Numerics.Tensors & RecyclableMemoryStream (Microsoft & .NET Foundation — MIT); F# & FSharp.Core (Don Syme, Microsoft & F# Software Foundation — MIT).
• Performance, Spatial & Compression: ZLinq & SimdLinq (Yoshifumi Kawai / Cysharp — MIT); CommunityToolkit.HighPerformance (Sergio Pedri & .NET Foundation — MIT); DotNext (Roman Sakno / .NET Foundation — MIT); BitFaster.Caching (Alex Peck — MIT); ZeroAlloc.Collections (Marcel Roozekrans — MIT); Equativ.RoaringBitmaps (Equativ Contributors & Daniel Lemire's Roaring format — Apache-2.0); RBush (Daniel Newman / viceroypenguin & Vladimir Agafonkin — MIT); K4os.Compression.LZ4 (Milosz Krajewski & Yann Collet — MIT); YamlDotNet (Antoine Aubry & contributors — MIT); Ben.Demystifier (Ben Adams & contributors — Apache-2.0).
• Profiling, Language Kit, Addons & Typography: Tracy Profiler (Bartosz Taudul — BSD-3-Clause) & Tracy-CSharp (clibequilibrium — MIT); optional LanguageKit integrations (godot-rust/gdext, godot-luau-script, gdext-nim, odin-godot, godot-jvm, lua-gdextension, godot-sandbox, gdzig, graphics.gd, py4godot); local Godot addons (Fennara, LimboAI, GodotSteam, Dialogue Manager, Ezcha Network, Lit); Source Serif 4 (Frank Grießhammer / Adobe — OFL-1.1).
• Open Map & Flag Data: ESA GlobCover 2009 (ESA & UCLouvain); NASA Earth Observatory Blue Marble (Jesse Allen / NASA) & GEBCO (BODC); Natural Earth (Public Domain); Wikimedia Commons flag illustrators.
